name: P03_cuban_chains
motion_prompt: Fixed panoramic camera. Heavy polished gold Cuban-link chains at the outer corners sway gently as if suspended, completing one slow pendulum cycle and returning to their original position. The connected links retain their solid rounded shapes and physical weight. Warm studio highlights drift along the links. The central matte-black space stays clear for performers. Contemporary luxury hip-hop atmosphere, smooth restrained movement, no new objects, no cuts or camera motion.
processing: Wan 2.2 first/last frame, 81 frames at 16 fps; crop 2 px top/bottom; optical-flow interpolation to 60 fps; cosine time remap forward then reverse over one 8-second cycle, delivered at 30 fps. Eased reversals avoid a hard cut or a tail-to-head dissolve. ProRes LT master and all-intra H.264 delivery.
